//: TECHNOLOGIES: Node.js npm, React 18, Vite 5, React Router v6,
This file defines ALL npm dependencies for the React frontend.
Run `npm install` after setting up this file. Below is the
specification of required packages and their purposes:
The core React library for building UI components.
Provides createRoot() and DOM rendering capabilities.
Route, Link, NavLink, useNavigate, useParams hooks.
Promise-based HTTP client for making API requests to
the Node.js and Flask backends. Supports interceptors
for automatically attaching JWT Authorization headers.
React charting library built on D3. Used in Dashboard.jsx
to render LineChart (booking trends), BarChart (top events),
Modern JavaScript date utility library. Used in EventCard.jsx
to format ISO date strings into human-readable formats.
Runtime prop type checking for React components.
Used in EventCard.jsx and other presentational components.
DEV DEPENDENCIES (devDependencies) — only used during development:
Next-generation frontend build tool. Provides extremely
fast HMR (Hot Module Replacement) for development and
Vite plugin that enables React JSX transform and
React Refresh for fast HMR without full page reloads.
JavaScript/JSX linter for catching code quality issues.
Enforces the Rules of Hooks (e.g., no hooks in loops).
TypeScript type definitions for React. Useful for IDE
name: passcraft-frontend
